page.overview:
Who is The Beast?

The Beast is a fictional entity created by Keith Herber for Chaosium's Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.

The Beast is an avatar of Nyarlathotep worshiped in Egypt. It is, in fact, one of the avatars associated with the Sphinx of Giza, the others being the Black Lion, destroyer of Egypt, and the Faceless God. (: The Fungi from Yuggoth)

Category:Avatars of Nyarlathotep Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works
